theater: 色雷斯翁加爾與君士坦丁堡城下

battle.name: 拜占庭—保加利亞戰爭
battle.theater: 色雷斯翁加爾與君士坦丁堡城下
battle.brief: 西元680年末，可汗克魯姆在翁加爾擊潰拜占庭色雷斯野戰軍，兵鋒直抵君士坦丁堡城牆，冬季圍城數月。拜占庭憑狄奧多西城牆、希臘火與金角灣艦隊守城未失；卡面的希臘重步兵方陣所代表的正面防禦傳統，正是這場攻防最底層的邏輯。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 交戰的一方是拜占庭帝國，即赫利克利王朝末期的東羅馬；680年前後的帝國西部由君士坦丁堡的中央政權直接支配，禁衛軍（tagsma，如 Scholai 與 Exkoubitai）駐守都城，色雷斯軍區（Opsikion）與安納托利亞軍區（Anatolikon）的地方駐軍構成本戰線的主力，每個軍區由總督（strategos）指揮，兵員與糧餉由軍區轄地的稅收負擔；兵種上以持矛具甲騎兵（kataphraktoi）與持盾重騎兵（skoutatoi）為骨幹，步兵居輔，海軍駐博斯普魯斯與金角灣。這已不是重裝步兵的時代：非洲自698年淪陷，帝國稅基只剩埃及、敘利亞與安納托利亞，小亞細亞西部兵源與錢糧都遠不如前，678年安基亞洛斯之勝靠的還是陣前欺敵的計策。另一方是第一保加利亞帝國，國主是已故可汗庫伯之子克魯姆；保加利亞沒有拜占庭那樣的常備軍與軍區制度，靠可汗直屬的精騎、各部落（birlik）的馬隊與徵發來的步兵編組軍隊，輔以工匠營造攻城器材，聯軍中還有斯拉夫人與阿瓦爾系殘部，以及被強迫造器械的希臘與亞美尼亞俘匠。第三方是帝國周邊的附庸與盟友：小亞細亞的臣服公國、亞美尼亞與喬治亞的貴族，以及北方草原的突厥；676年正是草原聯軍幫帝國打退過克魯姆，680年同一批援軍卻在最關鍵的時刻退回北方，保加利亞人趁勢再壓過海摩斯山。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Byzantine Empire, the East Rome of the closing Heraclian dynasty, and the First Bulgarian Empire, a nomadic confederation state on the Danube and the steppe. In 680 the western front of the Empire was run directly from Constantinople: the tagmata of the capital guard, the Scholai and the Exkoubitai, garrisoned the walls, while the field forces came from the Opsikion of Thrace and the Anatolikon of Asia Minor, each under a strategos, paid for and recruited from the lands of its theme. Cavalry was the arm of decision, the lance-bearing kataphraktoi and the shield-bearing skoutatoi, with infantry in support and the fleets of the Bosporus and the Golden Horn holding the sea lanes. This was no longer the age of the heavy infantry shield-wall; since the loss of Africa in 698 the revenue base of the Empire had shrunk to Egypt, Syria and the Anatolian core, and even the victory at Anchialus in 678 or 679 had been won by a ruse in front of the line rather than by weight of men. The other side had no standing army and no thematic system: the army was built from the khan's own picked cavalry, the mounted birlik of the clans and conscripted infantry, with artisan camps building siege engines; Slavs and Avar-descended contingents served in the same host, and captured Greek and Armenian craftsmen were set to work building machines for the besiegers. Around the conflict sat the Empire's clients and neighbours, the subject principalities of Asia Minor, the Armenian and Georgian princes to the east, and the steppe Turks of the northern plains, whose alliance with Byzantium had broken Krum's first offensive in 676 and would break again in 680, leaving the Bulgars free to push south over the Haemus once more.
people: 保加利亞方面最關鍵的人物是可汗克魯姆。他在希拉克略一朝就已與帝國交戰，676年被希拉克略聯合草原突厥的遠征軍打退，飲恨退回海摩斯山以北；669年之後他重整力量，奪取塞爾迪卡（今日索菲亞），680年又攻下德貝爾特與奧德索斯（今日瓦爾納），把黑海濱海大道與色雷斯平原的門戶握在手裡。翁加爾之役的勝利讓他把拜占庭的野戰軍打散，然後把軍隊開到君士坦丁堡的牆下。拜占庭方面的決策者卻在這一年裡連續更換：提比留斯三世於680年春被推翻，利奧三世在動亂中即位；都城的將領們選擇以「決鬥」而不是全面戰役來解決圍城——據狄奧多西·孔提努阿圖斯的記載，兩軍各出一名挑戰者在海上單挑，殺死了保加利亞方面的斯lav出身挑戰者，圍城因此解除。681年可汗克魯姆死去，拜占庭編年史說是兒子所為；其子奧穆爾塔格接位，於同年8月與利奧三世議和。主要史料是狄奧多西·克爾索拉利與狄奧多西·孔提努阿圖斯的編年史，晚出的還有十二世紀尼科拉·奥特蘭托的拉丁編年史，今日的考證則以迪米塔爾·安格洛夫的考訂為基礎。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Bulgarian side is Khan Krum. He had already been at war with the Empire in the reign of Heraclius, and in 676 was driven back north of the Haemus by the emperor's expedition in alliance with the steppe Turks; from 669 onward he rebuilt his strength, took Serdica, the modern Sofia, and in 680 also seized the fortresses of Debelt and Odessos, the modern Varna, holding both the Black Sea coastal road and the gate into the Thracian plain. His victory at Ongal broke the Byzantine field army and opened the road to the walls of Constantinople. On the Byzantine side the decision-makers changed hands in the middle of the campaign: Tiberius III was overthrown in the spring of 680 and Leontios III came to the throne amid the confusion; the commanders in the capital then chose to settle the siege by a duel rather than by a general action. According to Theophanes Continuatus each side produced a champion to fight it out at sea, the Bulgarian champion, a Slav by origin, was killed, and the siege was lifted. Krum died in 681, the Byzantine chroniclers alleging that his own son was responsible; his successor Omurtag took the khanly throne and made peace with Leontios III in August of the same year. The narrative rests on the chronicles of Theophanes the Confessor and Theophanes Continuatus, with the later Latin chronicle of Nicolaus of Otranto, and on the modern textual work of Dimitar Angelov.
kits: 卡面上的兵器是約西元前500年前後的希臘重步兵（hoplite）：奧區盾（aspis）、長矛（dory）、青銅頭盔與鎖子甲，身後站着標槍手與軍樂隊。誠實地說，680年的戰場上已經沒有這種方陣——拜占庭野戰軍的主力是具甲騎兵與輕騎，決定戰局的是馬上的矛與斧，步兵只是輔助。hoplite 在這個體系裡的位置，是它所代表的那套觀念與那套物質：一是用大盾把個人的正面變成整個方陣的正面，傷亡交換與士氣由編制承擔而非由個人承擔；二是長矛與短劍的近戰組合，直到七至八世紀仍在帝國的操典與軍令手冊裡被引用，例如 Maurice 的《戰略論》（Strategikon）在記述軍團裝備與操練時所沿用的這一整套語彙；三是晚期羅馬的「盾兵」（scutarii）與其後的「持盾兵」（skoutatoi）在裝備上直接承襲hoplite，盾面弧度與矛的長度都源於此。保加利亞方面的裝備是弓、刀、標槍、套索與馬；攻城技術上有攻城塔、撞槌、人力拉索與扭力投射機，以及填壕用的柴束與土袋，俘獲的希臘工匠被迫為攻城方造器械。拜占庭的守城端才是它的戰略核心：城頭的扭力弩砲（cheiroballistra）與希臘火、海峽內船上安裝的火焰投射器。希臘火的成分配方沒有可靠記載，後世說法多有推測，不宜當成定論；可以確定的是它必須在城牆上或船上現場調製，再以管線輸送。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Greek hoplite of about 500 BC: the aspis, the long dory, a bronze helmet and a mail shirt, backed by javelin men and the piper. Honestly stated, no such phalanx stood on a battlefield in 680. The core of the Byzantine field army was armoured and light cavalry, and what decided the issue was the lance and the sabre on horseback, with infantry in support. The hoplite's place in this system is the body of doctrine and the material inheritance behind it. First, the idea that a large shield turns the individual front into a single front for the formation, so that the exchange of casualties and the morale of the line are carried by the unit rather than by the man. Second, the close-combat pairing of long spear and short sword, which the drill literature of the seventh and eighth centuries still describes, in Maurice's Strategikon, in the vocabulary used for the equipment and manoeuvres of the thematic units. Third, the late Roman scutarii and the later skoutatoi, direct heirs of the hoplite in material terms, carrying the same shield curvature and the same spear length. The Bulgars fielded the bow, the sabre, the javelin, the lasso and the horse; on the siege side there were siege towers, rams, traction and torsion throwers, and fascines and sandbags for filling the ditch, with captured Greek craftsmen compelled to build machines for the besiegers. The Byzantine defensive apparatus was its strategic core: torsion artillery on the walls, the cheiroballistra, fed with Greek fire, and fire projectors mounted in warships in the Golden Horn. No reliable record of the composition of Greek fire survives and later recipes are speculation that should not be taken for fact; what is certain is that it had to be mixed on the wall or on board and piped to the projector.
tactics: 翁加爾的戰法核心是地形與騎兵。拜占庭野戰軍在色雷斯東部的開闊地帶展開：步兵結成密集陣線，騎兵在兩翼待命，這本是帝國面對草原衝擊的標準部署；但「翁加爾」在保加利亞語中意為「沼澤地」，戰場位於斯利文盆地一帶，地面開闊而鬆軟多水窪，正是重裝騎兵與大量輕騎可以縱橫馳突的地形。保加利亞聯軍不與步兵正面對撞，而是以馬隊反覆衝擊側翼與指揮中斷，突破之後緊咬潰兵不放，主將陣亡更令拜占庭陣形失去軸心。圍城階段，聯軍以攻城塔與撞槌逼近狄奧多西城牆，記載中攻城者曾把盾連成互相遮蔽的龜甲陣，試圖抵禦城頭的箭與火油，但希臘火與投射器使器械難以近牆；海上聯軍以船隻封鎖金角灣，帝國海軍以裝有火焰投射器的戰船守住海峽，屢次在港內交鋒。整場戰爭最特別的一點是「決鬥代替會戰」：編年史記載雙方同意各出一名勇士在海上單挑定勝負，希臘方面取勝後保加利亞解圍北撤——這是七至八世紀羅馬與草原集團之間以榮譽規則解決爭端的典型做法。真正決定勝負的其實是補給：帝國靠都城的穀倉、海運與黑海沿岸的稅收撐住圍城，保加利亞靠掠取色雷斯的穀物、酒與牲畜過冬，冬季營地的供給上限決定了圍城不能拖過春天。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of Ongal was the ground and the cavalry. The Byzantine field army deployed on the open country of eastern Thrace, infantry in dense lines with the cavalry held on the wings, the standard Imperial answer to a steppe charge. But the name Ongal means marsh in Bulgarian, and the battlefield lay in the Sliven basin, flat, waterlogged and soft underfoot, precisely the ground on which massed heavy and light horse could run. The Bulgar host did not collide with the infantry head on: it struck the flanks and the command repeatedly, stayed on the fugitives once the line was broken, and the fall of the Byzantine commander deprived the formation of its pivot. In the siege phase the host brought towers and rams against the Theodosian wall; the sources record the besiegers closing their shields into a mutually covering tortoise to withstand the arrows and the boiling oil poured from above, but Greek fire and the artillery kept the engines away from the curtain. At sea the host blockaded the Golden Horn, and the Imperial fleet, with fire projectors mounted in its hulls, held the strait and fought repeated engagements inside the harbour. The most unusual feature of the whole war is that a duel replaced a general battle: the chronicles record that both sides agreed to send a champion each to a single combat at sea, that the Greek side won, and that the Bulgars then lifted the siege and withdrew north, the arrangement by which Romans and steppe groups settled their disputes in the seventh and eighth centuries under the code of honour. Supply in fact decided everything: the Empire held out on the granaries of the capital, the sea convoys and the taxes of the Black Sea littoral, while the Bulgars lived off the grain, wine and cattle taken from Thrace, and the ceiling on what the winter camp could supply set the limit on how long the siege could last.
data: 可以核實的數字集中在防禦工程與行程上，而不在傷亡名冊上。君士坦丁堡的狄奧多西城牆陸線長約五點五公里，共設九十六座塔樓，牆頂道路寬度足以供車馬並行；金角灣海峽是帝國海軍的咽喉，第七世紀的拜占庭海軍以載數十人的划槳戰船為主力，船上可裝火焰投射器與撞角。行程上，可汗自塞爾迪卡向海摩斯山以南推進，再沿色雷斯東行至都城，直線距離約五百公里，途中拿下德貝爾特與奧德索斯這兩座控制黑海濱海大道的要塞。時間軸是：676年保加利亞被希拉克略與草原聯軍逐退；678或679年拜占庭在黑海南岸的安基亞洛斯取勝；680年保加利亞被逐過海摩斯山，同年晚秋翁加爾之役與圍城開始，圍城延續至681年；681年8月《德沃爾條約》簽訂。兵力方面，編年史只留下量級：拜占庭方面是色雷斯軍區與都城近衛合成的野戰軍，數千之眾；保加利亞聯軍被描述為數倍乃至數十倍於之，並在都城外形成合圍。傷亡數字沒有任何可靠記載，雙方史料都不提供可核的名冊，宜視為未知。編年史另記有圍城期間的日蝕異象，時間多被繫於680年12月。物資方面，條約要求拜占庭按年向保加利亞進貢，兩造說法在金額與貨物品類上不一，但可以確定與白銀有關；帝國的穀物供應線則經黑海港口與博斯普魯斯海關運入都城，而埃及自698年起已不在帝國手中。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked concern the fortifications and the marches, not casualty lists. The land line of the Theodosian walls of Constantinople runs about five and a half kilometres with ninety-six towers, and the roadway along the top is wide enough for wagons and horses to pass. The Golden Horn is the throat of the Imperial navy, and the seventh-century fleet was built on rowing galleys carrying several dozen men each, which could take a fire projector and a ram on board. As for distance, the khan's advance from Serdica south of the Haemus and then east across Thrace to the capital is roughly five hundred kilometres in a straight line, and on the way he took Debelt and Odessos, the two fortresses that commanded the Black Sea coastal road. The timeline runs as follows: in 676 the Bulgars were driven back by Heraclius and the steppe allies; in 678 or 679 Byzantium won at Anchialus on the south shore of the Black Sea; in 680 the Bulgars were pushed back north of the Haemus, and late that year came the battle of Ongal and the opening of the siege, which ran on into 681; in August 681 the Treaty of Devol was signed. On strength, the chronicles give orders of magnitude only: on the Byzantine side a field army assembled from the Opsikion and the capital guard, in the low thousands, while the Bulgar host is described as several times, in some passages several tens of times, larger and as closing in around the city. No reliable casualty figures exist, and neither side's sources supply a roster that can be checked, so they must be treated as unknown. The chronicles also record an eclipse during the siege, which is usually dated to December 680. On materiel, the treaty required Byzantium to pay an annual tribute to the Bulgars; the two traditions differ on the amount and on the list of goods, but the tribute is generally recorded as silver. The grain route of the Empire ran through the Black Sea ports and the customs of the Bosporus into the capital, Egypt having been lost to the Empire as early as 698.
cause: 打起來有兩層原因。直接的一層是克魯姆在680年重新奪回主動：他先取塞爾迪卡，再取德貝爾特與奧德索斯，把色雷斯平原與黑海濱海大道都變成自己的後方，然後長驅直指都城；而他之所以能忽然反攻，是因為679年帝國聯合葛剌兒與突厥的軍隊把保加利亞人趕回海摩斯山以北，680年聯盟卻在最關鍵的時刻破裂——拜占庭皇帝轉而攻打葛剌兒，草原援軍退回北方，保加利亞人重新壓回色雷斯。深層的一層是帝國自身的結構性疲弱：698年非洲淪陷後，帝國只剩安納托利亞、敘利亞與殘餘的埃及；626年阿瓦爾人曾圍過都城，678年雖在安基亞洛斯扳回一局，府庫卻已連年用兵而空虛；680年又遇上皇位更替，提比留斯三世在位不過數月便被推翻，利奧三世在動亂中即位，既缺錢也缺能打的野戰軍。更根本的對比在體制：拜占庭是守城與稅收為本的農耕帝國，邊防靠城牆與海軍；保加利亞是游牧聯軍國家，戰爭本身即是掠奪與遷徙，佔領色雷斯等於取得冬營的糧食與牧場，於是把前線一路推到對方首都的牆下。
causeEn: There were two layers of cause. The immediate one is that Krum recovered the initiative in 680: he took Serdica, then Debelt and Odessos, turned the Thracian plain and the Black Sea coastal road into his own rear area, and drove straight for the capital. He was able to counterattack suddenly because in 679 the Empire, in league with the Khazars and the Turks, had pushed the Bulgars back north of the Haemus, and in 680 that alliance broke at the decisive moment, the Byzantine emperor turning on the Khazars and the steppe allies withdrawing north, after which the Bulgars pressed back over Thrace. The deeper cause is the structural weakness of the Empire. With Africa lost in 698, there was left to it only Anatolia, Syria and a reduced Egypt; the Avars had besieged the capital in 626, and although the day was retrieved at Anchialus in 678 or 679, the treasury had been emptied by years of war; and 680 brought a change of emperor, Tiberius III thrown off after a bare few months and Leontios III enthroned amid the confusion, with neither money nor a serviceable field army to hand. At the bottom of it all lies a contrast of systems: Byzantium was a farming empire that fought from walls and lived on taxation, its frontier work done by fortifications and by the fleet; the Bulgarian state was a confederation of nomad hosts for which war was itself a form of raiding and migration, and the taking of Thrace meant winter quarters, grain and pasture, which pushed the front line all the way to the walls of the enemy capital.
impact: 這場戰爭終結了拜占庭在巴爾幹的希臘化進程，也重畫了東地中海的勢力邊界。色雷斯落入保加利亞，帝國在歐洲的據點退到薩洛尼基一線，海摩斯山成為帝國北界與保加利亞南界之間的天然分界；拜占庭失去歐洲的稅源、兵源與糧食走廊，此後再沒有能力把西線收回，帝國的資源改為向東與向南方集中，轉去應付679年以來再起的阿拉伯攻勢、安納托利亞與愛琴海的海防，以及與保加利亞接壤的邊境。對保加利亞而言，色雷斯帶來的是通向愛琴海與君士坦丁堡的門戶、可供冬營的耕地與牧場，以及與帝國長期並存的邊界；681年之後的「保加利亞和平」（pax Bulgarica）讓雙方在近半個世紀裡維持以邊境掠奪與外交並行的小規模摩擦，帝國偶爾以錢財換取安寧，873年與894年保加利亞更兩度以盟軍身分介入帝國與法蘭克、馬扎爾人的戰爭。另一層長遠影響落在宗教與文字上：保加利亞在864年接受基督教並與帝國的傳教網絡接上，同時代屬薩洛尼基的西里爾與梅索迪因喀爾斯坦之請前往摩拉維亞，把帝國的禮儀與文字帶到中歐，與邊境上的接觸同屬一個歐洲化的方向。軍事史上，這一役也是重裝步兵時代退場的標誌之一：勝負不再由方陣正面的強度決定，而由馬匹、投射器、城牆與糧食決定。
impactEn: This war brought the Hellenisation of the Balkans under the Empire to an end and redrew the balance of the eastern Mediterranean. Thrace passed to the Bulgars, the Empire's European holdings shrank back to the line of Thessalonica, and the Haemus became the natural boundary between the northern frontier of Byzantium and the southern frontier of Bulgaria. The Empire lost the revenue, the manpower and the grain corridor of Europe, and never again had the strength to recover the western front; its resources were turned eastward and southward instead, to meet the Arab offensive that had revived from 679, the maritime defence of Anatolia and the Aegean, and the new frontier along the Bulgarian border. For Bulgaria, Thrace brought the approaches to the Aegean and to Constantinople, arable land and pasture for the winter camps, and a long settled border with the Empire. The pax Bulgarica that followed in 681 kept relations between the two powers in a pattern of small-scale border raiding and diplomacy for nearly half a century, the Empire paying occasionally for quiet, and Bulgaria serving as an ally of the Empire against the Franks and the Magyars in 873 and again in 894. A further long-term consequence lay in religion and letters: Bulgaria accepted Christianity in 864 and was drawn into the Empire's missionary network, while Cyril and Methodius, natives of Thessalonica, were sent at the request of Khreston's people to Moravia and carried the Empire's liturgy and letters into central Europe, the same direction as the contact on this frontier. In military history the campaign also marks the retirement of the age of heavy infantry: the issue was no longer decided by the strength of a phalanx front, but by horses, artillery, walls and grain.
result: 軍事上雙方各有所得：保加利亞在翁加爾擊敗拜占庭野戰軍、攻下色雷斯並把都城逼入圍城，但沒有能力攻破狄奧多西城牆，最終解圍北撤；拜占庭保住了都城與海軍，卻付出了承認保加利亞佔有色雷斯的政治代價。681年可汗克魯姆死去，其子奧穆爾塔格於同年8月與利奧三世簽訂《德沃爾條約》：條約大致以海摩斯山山麓與通賈河一線劃界，保加利亞保有色雷斯與黑海沿岸的奧德索斯等據點，拜占庭在色雷斯南端保留若干城邑與駐軍，並承諾按年支付以白銀為主的年貢、遣返被俘兵員，兩國以「友誼」之名交換使節。戰爭的直接結果是拜占庭承認既成事實，間接結果是帝國放棄西進，轉向以安納托利亞與愛琴海為核心的守勢，保加利亞則把色雷斯變成向南、向西經營的跳板。對這張卡上的希臘重步兵而言，這場戰爭是一個註腳：680年的色雷斯平原上，再沒有任何一支部成方陣的重步兵決定戰局，勝負交給了馬匹、投射器、城牆與糧食。
resultEn: In military terms each side gained something. The Bulgars beat the Byzantine field army at Ongal, took Thrace and drove the capital into a siege, but they had no means of breaching the Theodosian wall and finally lifted the siege and withdrew north; Byzantium saved the capital and its fleet, but paid the political price of recognising the Bulgarian possession of Thrace. Krum died in 681, and in August of that year his successor Omurtag signed the Treaty of Devol with Leontios III: the frontier was drawn broadly along the foot of the Haemus and the line of the Tundzha, the Bulgars kept Thrace and the Black Sea stronghold of Odessos, Byzantium retained certain towns and garrisons at the southern edge of Thrace, and undertook an annual tribute of silver together with the return of prisoners, the two powers exchanging envoys in the language of friendship. The immediate outcome was the Empire's acceptance of accomplished fact; the indirect outcome was that the Empire gave up any attempt to advance westward and settled into a defensive posture centred on Anatolia and the Aegean, while Bulgaria turned Thrace into a springboard for its own expansion south and west. For the Greek hoplite on this card the war is a footnote: on the Thracian plain in 680 no phalanx of heavy infantry decided anything any more, and the issue went to horses, artillery, walls and grain.
